task: GASP-14 Full CMC bake to Manny
scope: Offline bake of every sequence, blend space and montage the CMC pawn plays in locomotion and traversal (71 Relaxed databases of the CMC chooser, the CMC traversal chooser and database, the AnimBP blend spaces) from UEFN onto the Lyra SK_Mannequin, Manny copies of the Motion Matching data and of ABP_RpgGasp_CMC, and an isolated development pawn. Gameplay pawns, the Mover and the shared UEFN databases are unchanged.

differences_from_official: Pin IK Bones op added (as in GASP-08)
Retarget FK Chains: Root chain GloballyScaled -> Absolute (as in GASP-08)
Pelvis Motion: BlendToAbsoluteOffset (1,1,0) in GASP-08 -> (1,1,1) here, so clips with vertical root motion keep pelvis and feet on the root

interaction_bone_substitution.reason: GASP's traversal schemas and montage warp notifies read the UEFN-only bone 'attach'. Adding it to SK_Mannequin changed the skeleton GUID, so every one of the 1,813 assets on SK_Mannequin was re-conformed on each load. The user chose on 2026-10-17 to carry the attach motion on Lyra's existing, unanimated 'interaction' bone (child of root, like 'attach') instead.
interaction_bone_substitution.schema_channels: PSC_Traversal_Pos and PSC_Traversal_Head: Bone attach -> interaction (queries come from BP_GetWorldPositionFromContext and do not read the bone)

modified_existing_assets.change: Added blend profile FastFeet_InstantRoot, copied by bone name from SK_UEFN_Mannequin, which the traversal montages blend out with. No bone or hierarchy change; the skeleton GUID is unchanged. Rollback reverts this file.

remaining_outside_references: 86 baked sequences reference the experimental UEFN state-machine databases PSD_SM_CMC_* (as their sources do; the experimental path is off)
CHT_CMCCharacterAnimations (Manny copy) still references 387 UEFN sequences; it is the experimental chooser, kept only as context for the AnimBP
AC_RpgGasp_TraversalQuery_Manny references the Mover chooser CHT_TraversalMontages_Mover, like its CMC source
ABP_RpgGasp_CMC_Manny references the curve asset AO_Blend_Curve; the traversal schemas use the shared PSC_Traversal_* channel classes
RTG_UEFN_to_Manny_Bake references IK_UEFN_Mannequin as its source rig

metrics.preservation: 556/556 pairs (522 sequences and blend spaces, 34 montages) keep length, frame count, root-motion flags, rate scale, additive settings, curve names, key counts and values, notifies (class and time), sync markers, montage slot segments (pointing at the baked sequences) and blend in/out, and blend-space samples; the only differences are 2 contact curves where the bake dropped a duplicate source key at the same time (M_Relaxed_Run_Turn_R_180_Lfoot contact_r, M_Relaxed_Walk_Stop_B_Lfoot contact_l). Audited before the interaction-track and warp-bone edits, which change only the interaction bone keys and the warp point bone name.
